reason: A web GUI monitoring plugin that reads DeepSeek CNY balance data, estimates consumption and remaining duration, and provides threshold-based visual and browser notifications.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示人民币余额、当日消耗和预计可用时长，并提供低余额与低余量告警。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek CNY balance, daily consumption, and estimated remaining usage time in the web interface with low-balance and low-duration alerts.

capabilities: Reads the official DeepSeek balance endpoint
Tracks balance changes to estimate daily consumption
Projects approximate remaining usage duration from recent consumption
Displays balance and usage information in a web interface
Shows low-balance and low-duration status indicators
Can trigger browser notifications when configured thresholds are reached
